# Brian Phillips — Fractional CTO & Technical Leadership

> Brian Phillips is a Fractional CTO and engineering leader with 15+ years in
> mobile and full-stack engineering. He steps into stalled, unstable, or
> under-led engineering and gets products shipping reliably again, for startup
> founders, SMBs, and enterprise teams. Work is fully remote.

## What he does

- **Fractional CTO**: Part-time executive ownership of engineering — direction, team, vendors, and delivery — for companies that need senior technical leadership but not a full-time hire.
- **Delivery recovery**: Stabilizing and re-sequencing stalled or failing software projects until they ship predictably again.
- **Vendor oversight**: Acting as the client's technical authority over agencies and offshore teams that are underdelivering.
- **Architecture modernization**: Reworking systems that have become the bottleneck as a company scales.
- **Technical advisory**: Ongoing senior guidance for founders and leaders on strategy, hiring, and architecture.

## How he works

His recovery approach is **assess, stabilize, strengthen**: get an honest read on
the code, team, and vendors; stop the immediate problems so delivery resumes;
then make the structural fixes once shipping is safe. He uses AI-assisted
engineering workflows to move faster without lowering quality, and has led
remote and distributed teams for most of his career.

## Engagement models

- **Technical Advisory** — monthly retainer
- **Fractional CTO** — ongoing, part-time
- **Architecture & Delivery Audit** — fixed scope, fixed fee
- **Delivery Recovery** — scoped per engagement

Engagements are structured as monthly retainers or fixed-scope projects rather
than hourly billing. He takes on a small number of clients at a time.

## Specialties

Mobile and full-stack engineering (Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, React Native), backend
and cloud (AWS), CI/CD and release discipline, engineering leadership, team and
vendor management, and technical strategy.

## Selected experience

Work for Tommy Car Wash Systems (consumer app and POS across 250+ locations,
2M+ users), Nike, Amazon, Toyota, PepsiCo (Super Bowl halftime campaign), NAV
Canada, IBM, and Rigetti. Maintainer of the open-source MAVSDK-Swift project.
